info.name: M37 - Budgets + Forecasts + Procurement Advisory
info.description:
API collection for M37 — budget CRUD, GL actuals refresh, franchise forecast runs, demand calendar management, and procurement advisory suggestions.

Manual checklist:
1. Run Auth — Login Owner
2. Run Auth — Get Branch ID
3. List Budgets (empty)
4. Create Budget → captures {{budgetId}}
5. Get Budget by ID
6. Update Actuals (GL refresh)
7. List Budgets (with status filter)
8. List Demand Calendar
9. Create Demand Calendar Entry → captures {{demandCalendarId}}
10. Get Demand Calendar Entry by ID
11. Update Demand Calendar Entry
12. Get Forecast (force refresh) → captures {{forecastRunId}}
13. Get Forecast (cached)
14. List Procurement Suggestions → captures {{procurementSuggestionId}}
15. Review Procurement Suggestion (REVIEWED)
16. Review Procurement Suggestion (DISMISSED — non-PENDING → 400)
17. Delete Demand Calendar Entry
